column1: # Rule: a pixel processor's start state at pixel (x, y) of a W x H node: Jenkins' one-at-a-time hash over three 32-bit
# words (not bytes): the seed as an integer, then the IEEE bits of the floats u = (x + 0.5) / W and v = (y + 0.5) / H
# (computed in single precision): h = 0; for each word: h += w; h += h << 10; h ^= h >> 6; then h += h << 3; h ^= h >> 11;
